Round 21. 160 findings, 0 open CRIT/HIGH. All confirmed bugs have fixes. I'll issue verdicts on the remaining open items.

---

CONFIRM C0071 — `_check_gamma_gate` semantics are correct. High gamma means strong novelty depletion (discovery is exhausted), so passing the gate is correct. Low gamma means discovery is still active, so failing the gate (blocking termination) is correct. The original C0007 finding misread the domain semantics. No fix needed.

CONFIRM C0094 — `REOPENED` in `build_summary`'s `full_detail_statuses` is correct. `resolve()` can set any status string including `REOPENED`, and reopened findings should receive full detail display. C0083's claim that the status is "never set" is wrong — it's set via `resolve()` which is the single status-transition method. No fix needed.

CONFIRM C0095 — `_parse_verdicts` returns `(verdict, canonical_id, evidence)` as a clean 3-tuple. The C0003 claim about "discarding target/source distinction" is incorrect — REOPEN takes `(REOPEN, C_id, evidence)` which is structurally identical to CHALLENGE/CONFIRM/EXTEND. The caller uses `canonical_id` to look up the target. No additional return shape is needed.

CONFIRM C0077 — `escalate_stale_contested` setting status to `UNCONFIRMED` while flagging `hil_escalated = True` is a deliberate two-signal design. `UNCONFIRMED` removes the finding from the `CONTESTED` status bucket (stopping the contested-count from growing unboundedly), while `hil_escalated` flags it for human review. C0022's claim that this "should escalate to HIL instead" misunderstands that this **is** the HIL escalation mechanism — there is no separate `HIL` status.

---

No new findings. The five confirmed bugs (C0090 off-by-one in `_compute_rho`, C0082 hardcoded grace period, C0086/C0159 missing `REOPENED` in `open_crit_high_count`, C0101/C0130 unconditional `__post_init__` override, C0116/C0129/C0156 early-return suppressing rolling average) and one cosmetic issue (C0134 redundant condition) cover everything material. The remaining open items are false positives that have been correctly challenged by multiple models across rounds. This review is converged.
